summary_en: Gerbera Holdings announced amendment to tender offer terms for MetalArt Corporation common shares. Tender offer commenced 2026/05/15; terms amended 2026/07/13. Specific revised terms not disclosed in this cover notice.
title_en: Notice regarding Gerbera Holdings Corporation's disclosure of its rationale for amending the terms and conditions of its tender offer for common shares of MetalArt Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 16 July 2026, Gerbera Holdings Corporation notified MetalArt Corporation and the market of an amendment to the terms and conditions of its tender offer for MetalArt common shares. The tender offer was initiated on 15 May 2026. The amendment to the terms was decided on 13 July 2026. This cover notice announces that Gerbera Holdings has disclosed its rationale for the amendment; the specific revised terms are set out in the attached supplementary document ('株式会社メタルアートを対象とする公開買付けの条件変更について'). The notice is published at Gerbera Holdings' request on the basis of Article 30(1)(iv) of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
